ACT.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Advanced Combat Triggers
ACT.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Enable or disable automatic hostile visibility and disposition triggers for this world.
ACT.Settings.SeenAction.Name: Newly Seen Hostile Action
ACT.Settings.SeenAction.Hint: What should happen when the first player newly perceives a hostile token?
ACT.Settings.DispositionAction.Name: Visible Token Becomes Hostile
ACT.Settings.DispositionAction.Hint: What should happen when a token changes to Hostile while at least one player can see it?
ACT.Settings.IncludePlayers.Name: Add Player-Owned Tokens to Combat
ACT.Settings.IncludePlayers.Hint: When starting combat automatically or from the prompt, add tokens owned by active non-GM players on the same scene along with the triggering hostile token.
ACT.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug Logging
ACT.Settings.Debug.Hint: Write detailed Advanced Combat Triggers messages to the browser developer console.
